name: cx-goal-one-rule
task: Open the door and then pick up the box in the other room, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard plus Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'open the door and then pick up the box in the other room' — the hard chain forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed. Absence(key_lost) soft matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed': key_lost is defined as losing the key while the door is closed, so the 'while closed' condition is built into the proposition, and 'try not to' correctly makes it soft.

texts: Pick up the target box in the other room.
Open the door before picking up the target box.
Preferably, do not lose the key while the door is still closed.
